name: orca-crew
description: The orchestrator/worker session model over Orca orchestration. An orchestrator session (claude on Fable, or claude-sol) keeps its context for decisions and dispatches everything else to GLM sessions launched by alias: claude-glm or claude-glm-flash implement by complexity class, one claude-glm-flash session runs /code-review once per PR, the retained implementer works GitHub threads to zero, merge only on the operator's word. A session budget caps each work item at one implementer and one verifier. Since 0.3.0 a spine planned in that same session runs in three layers: the orchestrator ratifies a per-item implementer/verifier profile into an orca-execution/v1 sidecar and starts one spine session, that session creates a child Run and owns both item terminals per item, nested worker depth 2 is required with no fallback, no inherited-runtime subagent runs there, and the reviewer is chosen only at the PR. Defers every other Orca command to the Orca binary's own guide. No lib, no hooks, no state.
